mentions.name: Ancient Earth globe
mentions.description: An interactive globe that uses plate tectonic data to show where a location was on Earth hundreds of millions of years ago. Recently added new high-res maps, a timeline, and country names and borders; supports toggling borders, names, and rotation, e.g. to view Pangaea.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I'm making my Ancient Earth globe better.  It uses plate tectonic data to show you where your city was on the globe hundreds of millions of years ago.

Recently added new high-res maps, a timeline, and country names and borders.

For example, see Pangaea:

https://dinosaurpictures.org/ancient-earth?borders=on&names=on&rotation=off#240
